6e156d65-cf65-4d5b-9d04-52f2f8100fbf.title: Isekai Mokushiroku Mynoghra: Hametsu no Bunmei de Hajimeru Sekai Seifuku
6e156d65-cf65-4d5b-9d04-52f2f8100fbf.altTitle: Isekai Apocalypse Mynoghra ~The Conquest of the World Starts With the Civilization of Ruin~
6e156d65-cf65-4d5b-9d04-52f2f8100fbf.description:
Bedridden and abandoned, Takuto Ira spent his days in the hospital trying to beat the illness that was slowly killing him. His only solace lay in the nation management strategy game Eternal Nations, where he had built a reputation as the greatest player to ever live. 

After succumbing to his disease, Takuto awoke within the game next to Atou — the Hero unit for his favorite civilization, Mynoghra. Now they’ll set out to conquer the world together (again), one unit, settlement, and level at a time!

600f467c-9613-4056-aa21-bb2ecc295b84.title: Osananajimi Kanojo no Morahara ga Hidoin de Zetsuen Sengen shite Yatta
600f467c-9613-4056-aa21-bb2ecc295b84.altTitle: I Dared to Declare Goodbye to My Emotionally Abusive Childhood Sweetheart
600f467c-9613-4056-aa21-bb2ecc295b84.description: My childhood friend is also my girlfriend. A dream come true, right? Hell no. She insults me on a daily basis. She grinds my dignity into shreds and it takes a toll on my mental well-being. I can't take it anymore. So I'm left with no choice, I'm going to break up with her. In order to maintain my sanity, it's the only option.

9422a147-c0c8-400d-9106-57cb8ece3dba.title: Kimi wa Maid-sama
9422a147-c0c8-400d-9106-57cb8ece3dba.description: ||Seorang gadis dengan pakaian pelayan datang ke rumah Hitoyoshi untuk mencari pekerjaan. Pekerjaan dia sebelumnya adalah seorang pembunuh, dan dia sangat ahli dalam semua teknik membunuh, tapi dia sangat awam dalam pekerjaan rumah. Hitoyoshi bingung dengan permintaan anehnya itu dan memintanya pergi. Tapi kemudian gadis itu menyelamatkan Hitoyoshi dari sebuah kecelakaan maut, dan Hitoyoshi pikir dia mungkin bisa mempekerjakannya? Ini adalah kisah tentang seorang pelayan yang dulunya adalah pembunuh berdarah dingin kini belajar tentang emosi baru. Seorang pelayan yang hidup kesepian di dunia bawah akhirnya menemukan keluarga. Awal kehidupan sehari-hari yang menyenangkan dimulai!||

4a43c227-b201-4fb7-b796-924c51797d50.title: Level Up with the Gods
4a43c227-b201-4fb7-b796-924c51797d50.description:
“Maybe Inner Gods can never defeat Outer Gods…” so thought Yuwon Kim, a plucky, high-ranking warrior, after a bitter defeat.

But Yuwon is too tenacious to give up. His loss becomes the dawn of a new journey as a returnee. With renewed determination, Yuwon starts back from where he began, smashing monster after monster and relearning his skills before taking on the Tower once again.

But can he fight his way through the tutorials and level up once more, or will his conquest crumble before him?

cc92f469-2e2d-4747-b753-6c1bf354cb74.title: Osaka Loop Line
cc92f469-2e2d-4747-b753-6c1bf354cb74.description:
Kim Yong, a Zainichi Korean boy from Osaka, accidentally gets caught up in a fight with the nephew of a yakuza. 

Kim Yong is given the mission of infiltrating a Korean village and stealing an ID card by order of the yakuza. The villagers, who seemed ordinary, seem to be up to something... 

At first, he only thought of completing the mission and receiving money, but Kim Yong gradually becomes one with the villagers and joins the village's goal of establishing a homeland in Osaka.

99daf7bc-3a3b-4fe8-b10d-951b32bfea64.title: Gimai Seikatsu
99daf7bc-3a3b-4fe8-b10d-951b32bfea64.description:
From classmates to brother and sister, living under the same roof.
After his father’s remarriage, Asamura Yuuta ends up getting a new stepsister, coincidentally the number one beauty of the school year, Ayase Saki. Having learned important values when it comes to man-woman relationships through the previous ones of their parents, they promise each other not to be too close, not to be too opposing, and to merely keep a vague and comfortable distance.
On one hand, Saki, who has worked in solitude for the sake of her family, doesn’t know how to properly rely on others, whereas Yuuta is unsure of how to really treat her. Standing on fairly equal ground, these two slowly learn the comfortable sensation of living together. Their relationship slowly evolves from being strangers the more the days pass. Eventually, this could end up in a story about love for all we know.

8b429d8e-0b9c-404c-b65b-82e4eab9321f.title: Nakama ni Uragirare Shokei Sareta Necromancer, Undead-ka Shiteita Eiyuu 10000-nin o Sosei shi Saikyou no Oukoku o Tsukuri Fukushuu o Kaishi Suru: An'ei no Gyokuza ni Eirei o Tsudou
8b429d8e-0b9c-404c-b65b-82e4eab9321f.altTitle: A Necromancer Betrayed by His Comrades and Executed Revives 10,000 Heroes Who Had Become Undead, Builds the Most Powerful Kingdom, and Begins His Quest for Revenge.: Heroic Spirits Gather at the Throne of Darkness
8b429d8e-0b9c-404c-b65b-82e4eab9321f.description:
Crow, a necromancer, was betrayed by his comrades and cast into the Abyss.
Yet he revived by devouring the miasma, fully resurrected the 10,000 heroic spirits who had once been destroyed, and founded the mightiest of kingdoms.
Thus, with an army of ancient warriors at his command, Crow carries out a gruesome and relentless revenge against his former comrades who betrayed him and the god who was the root of all evil…!

7d7068e4-071e-4445-ae2f-d6a2f45c0855.title: Gentle Man
7d7068e4-071e-4445-ae2f-d6a2f45c0855.description: F1 free practice was taking place in Monaco, Italy. Many famous and highly skilled drivers, such as Ayrton Senna and Nigel Mansell, considered prodigies of racing, were participating. Suddenly, a mysterious test driver appeared, sticking right behind Senna and Mansell and challenging them! While each team was in a state of shock, wondering "Who is this guy!", he overtook them in a flash from the inside of the tunnel, even though it wasn't a serious race during free practice! The name of this daredevil driver is Yaoyao Man. And Man says, "F1 is just child's play"... But who exactly is this Japanese driver who suddenly appeared in the world of F1...? This is the story of Yaoyao Man, a racing driver who drives by instinct!

7a284748-b36e-4ef4-8fab-2802a944276b.title: Cheonjae, Sesangeul Ikda
7a284748-b36e-4ef4-8fab-2802a944276b.altTitle: The Genius Who Sees Through the World
7a284748-b36e-4ef4-8fab-2802a944276b.description: As a child, Shin Woo-jin was kidnapped and locked away in a warehouse, forced to live as a slave. But against all odds, he was rescued and finally stepped into the outside world. Though free, Woo-jin wasn’t like other children. He had an extraordinary gift—the ability to read people. By observing the smallest facial expressions and unconscious gestures, he could see through their thoughts, emotions, and intentions with near-perfect accuracy. Like a profiler, like a modern-day Sherlock, Woo-jin learned to navigate the world, one observation at a time. But for someone who sees too much, living an ordinary life is the hardest thing of all. All he ever wanted was a peaceful, simple life. But the world had other plans. “As I thought… living a normal life is far too difficult.”

19c0fc79-b698-4be5-84c5-33fa4a7e1e0c.title: The Slumbering Ranker
19c0fc79-b698-4be5-84c5-33fa4a7e1e0c.description:
“We’re only taking a break for about 30 seconds? I’m not imagining things, right?”
 “…Yes.” 

After 15 hours of hunting, Hyunsung asked to rest for a while, and after 30 seconds, he had to get up again and started hunting.
Actually, Hyunsung has a special skill.

[Thananos’ narcolepsy skill is activated.]
[You’re being forced into a sleep state.]

After sleeping for a while and waking up, I got an item? 
Pay close attention to the story of the God-Rank Class, the descendant of Thananos, the unstoppable Hyunsung.

0d7c3646-3aed-4ab5-90c4-0d7c5aeae39a.description: A story of growth of 20-year-old youth turns into real adults.
